events.title: Dynamics in U.S.-Japan Semiconductor Partnership For National Security
events.location: CSIS, 1616 Rhode Island Ave NW, Washington, DC
events.description: Discussion of U.S. and Japanese assets and capabilities, and the challenges and opportunities for semiconductor cooperation for national security.
events.why: Allied chip supply-chain cooperation is core ETI terrain and CSIS is a short walk from SAIS.

events.title: The Tenth US-ROK Joint Public-Private Economic Forum: Advancing Economic Security and Industrial Strength
events.location: Hudson Institute, 1201 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC
events.description: Annual U.S.-South Korea public-private forum on economic security, industrial strength and supply chains, with Rep. Ami Bera, Elaine Chao, Wendy Cutler and others.
events.why: Economic-security and industrial-base agenda with Korea overlaps ETI's chips and supply-chain interests.

events.title: The Bitter Struggle: Superintelligence, Superpowers, and the Fate of the World (Georgetown)

events.why: AI and US-China competition book talk; same book ETI is hosting the next day.
